author: Jarocki, 1819
summary: 1989년 9월 광주 무등산에서 5마리가 관찰된 기록이 있는 미조이다. 보통 평지와 구릉의 숲, 덤불에 산다. 유럽 동북부와 러시아 시베리아 서부, 바이칼호 일대에서 번식하고, 시베리아 서부 알타이 지역, 중앙아시아, 이란에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: black face, chin, throat and upper breast

art.subject: Black-throated Thrush (Turdus atrogularis), adult male in fresh autumn plumage (September): crown, upperparts, wings and central tail feathers plain grey-brown with an olive tinge; lores, sides of the head, chin, throat and upper breast black, forming a bib with a sharp lower edge, the black partly veiled by narrow whitish feather fringes in autumn; lower breast and belly white; flanks washed grey with faint streaks; outer tail feathers plain dark brown. Bill dark with a yellow base; dark eye; legs brown.
art.pose: perched at the edge of a thicket, side view
art.scene: Korean lowland and hill woodland with thickets in autumn; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: plain olive-tinged grey-brown crown and upperparts, black face, chin, throat and upper breast forming a bib, white lower breast and belly, greyish flanks, yellow-based bill
adult male, tail detail from above: olive-tinged grey-brown central tail feathers and plain dark brown outer tail feathers, with no rufous in the tail
art.build: Medium-large thrush, 23–25 cm, about the size of a Dusky Thrush and plumper than a Brown-eared Bulbul. Upright stance with a round head and a plain face; adult males show no pale supercilium. Bill straight and slender, shorter than the head. Legs medium-long, brownish. Tail medium length, square-ended, plain. In flight orange-buff underwing coverts.
avoid: Do not paint a rufous-red throat or rufous outer tail feathers; that is Red-throated Thrush (Turdus ruficollis).
Do not add the chestnut wings, white supercilium or black-scaled flanks of Dusky Thrush (Turdus eunomus).
Do not spot or streak the white belly heavily.
Do not show a pale supercilium on the adult male.
